name: Write a model's story
description: The owner writes the model's one story: `{title, body}`, the title one line of up to 80 characters and the text up to 20,000, headings, links and lists in it, no picture. A baseline's story is the team's, so an admin writes it. ONE UPSERT DECIDES: text_hold_tag() over the title and the text, with links allowed since links are a story's normal content. A clean text replaces the approved one at once and clears any held edit. A text that carries a listed word waits in pending_* with its tag, and the public keeps reading the approved text -- so a first story that trips the list stays hidden until an admin approves it. Answers the writer's view, approved and pending side by side. A model the caller may not write answers 404, like one that does not exist; a title or text off its rule (the write's predicates, the table's CHECKs) is 400 `story_invalid`.
